subject: Re: EvaNet status: ensemble reproduced, flow cost is the trade-off
body:
Team,

Decision for the Jul 20 pre-read: adopting Yusuf's two-tier proposal exactly. Default tier is RGB-only at 74.3%, high-accuracy tier runs the full RGB+flow ensemble at 76.8%, priced to reflect the ~3x inference cost. Partners choose per-workload; the pre-read presents it as a cost/accuracy dial, not a compromise.

Also decided at portfolio review:
1. The June partner evaluation numbers held up (both partners saw within 0.5 points of our validation slice on their own archives), so the pilot commitment goes in the pre-read as evidence, not aspiration.
2. Scope cut: no fine-tuning on partner data in v1. Pretrained checkpoints only. Fine-tuning becomes the fast-follow with its own eval plan - trying to squeeze it in before Jul 27 was making the doc worse.

Deshawn, staffing shape holds through window close; nothing changes.

Thanks all - clean execution on this one.

Lucia
